title: Families protest as police seal venues days after high court order against banquet halls in South Delhi's Sainik Farm

ai.summary: Families in South Delhi's Sainik Farm protested after police sealed banquet halls without prior notice, citing safety concerns from a high court order against illegal venues. They faced last-minute cancellations and financial losses.

facts.quote: Senior police officials said they sealed seven of the venues by Tuesday afternoon.

facts.claim: high court ordered action against illegal banquet halls
facts.quote: On November 19, the high court gave directions while hearing a petition by a local organisation complaining about illegal marriage venues and banquet halls – those without any fire safety clearance or statutory permissions from the MCD.

facts.claim: families reported wedding cancellations and financial losses
facts.quote: Ravita Saha was supposed to get married on Tuesday but was instead found protesting outside the venue.

facts.claim: families demanded alternative venues and refunds
facts.quote: We had to pay for everything three months back only. Now, on Tuesday, we found the venue being locked and sealed.

ai.background_note: High court directed action against illegal banquet halls in South Delhi's Sainik Farm following a petition about fire safety and permissions, leading to police sealing venues and family protests over wedding cancellations.
